$comment: What the SDK schema cannot say about the Swift side of each generated CmuxNextDaemon request type (swift_app/emit.py explains the rules). A family is one Requests/<Family> folder; it moves here from hand-written Swift in one change.

Shell.$comment: shell-runs-v1. The replies are hand-written (the schema types them as JSON) in Shell/ShellRunReplies.swift, with the run id and the read timeout.

shell-run.name: ShellRunRequest
doc: `shell-run {command, cwd?, scope?, run?}`: starts `command` in `cwd` on the chat's machine under the id `run`
(chosen here, so a start whose answer is lost can still be stopped); `{run}` or `{refused}`.

shell-read.name: ShellReadRequest
doc: `shell-read {run, after}`: output after `after`, answered when there is some or the command ended,

shell-stop.name: ShellStopRequest
doc: `shell-stop {run}`: Ctrl-C to the command's process group, then SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

list-terminals.name: ListTerminalsRequest
doc: `list-terminals`: every terminal in the daemon's registry with its workspace and, once ended, its exit
